scope: Independent source/metadata/static scientific code review before HRS final release. No sampler import/call, HRS generation, clinical fit or output-table read.

verified.Gamma: mu=exp(Xbeta), shape=1/phi, scale=mu*phi; phi=0.02598182; conditional variance phi*mu^2.
verified.random_dependence: Shared Gaussian subject intercept and age60 slope, stated correlation; independent visit residuals. Baseline covariates repeat across four visits.
verified.age_and_spline: Continuous uniform source bins, including80-100; age60=(baseline_age+visit_time-60)/10; HbA1c branches min/max(hba1c-6.5,0).
verified.law_structure: Source recursive cell/age -> CSES -> education -> HbA1c -> longitudinal memory factorization; local seeded NumPy stream; no target calibration, clipping or rescaling.

variance_precision.classification: Disclosed source-precision choice, not implementation error; candidates are not numerically identical laws.
variance_precision.interpretation: Agent uses printed variances; native reconstructs from printed SDs in source covariance formula. No claim that either convention reproduces unavailable unrounded fitted objects more exactly.
